newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC unit bags second Indonesian contract.
newsitem.headline: PNOC unit bags second Indonesian contract.

text.p: The Philippine National Oil Co (PNOC) said on Monday its subsidiary, the PNOC-Energy Development Corp, has been awarded a second drilling contract in Indonesia.

In a statement, PNOC-EDC manager Roberto Abanes said the company would use one of its rigs to drill seven geothermal wells for Mandala Nusanatara Ltd, an Indonesian firm that is drilling the Wayang Windu geothermal field on Java island.
PNOC said the one-year contract is worth $3.5 million. Last March, PNOC-EDC was contracted by Asamera Oil of Canada to drill an oil and gas field in Indonesia's South Sumatra.
PNOC has decided to pursue international drilling contracts with the slowdown of geothermal drilling activities in the Philippines. PNOC owns and operates nine drilling rigs.
